findings.finding: The runtime did not directly verify the successor outer-to-inner-to-exact-member seal at every controller, worker, science, and publication boundary; controller and worker source hashes were live self-reports rather than hashes frozen by the inner manifest.

HELLO, envelope, ACK, worker result, and attempt receipt lacked a single exact-keyset validator chain and complete cross-binding of transport identity, source authority, pipe authority, closure authority, source hashes, scientific payload hash, and solver accounting through publication readback.
